indiaFitNotes.title: Skin type and climate fit
indiaFitNotes.detail: Formulations and shades tested on other populations may not suit Indian skin tones and humid climates. Check ingredient claims and patch-test guidance.

indiaFitNotes.title: Cosmetics regulation
indiaFitNotes.detail: Imported cosmetics need CDSCO import registration, and labels must carry required declarations.
